modal.title: You're trying TheOdooAgent
modal.subtitle:
An agent that queries and operates your Odoo.
This is a demo running on sample data.

chips.language: Ask in your language: sales, invoices, stock
chips.noInvent: It doesn't make up numbers: the system computes them, not the model
chips.anyOdoo: Works on any Odoo: 14 to 19 and Community

tryThis.overdue_invoices: How many overdue invoices are there this month?

hook.title: TheOdooAgent
hook.line: Talk to your Odoo in plain language. Query and operate your ERP like you'd talk to a colleague — real data, charts and exports, no menu hunting.

what.heading: Ask, and it answers with your real data
what.line: It reads your question, queries your Odoo and answers instantly. It also operates —create, confirm, update— always with your confirmation.
what.chip2: Sales by rep last month, as a chart

different.heading: What Odoo's native AI doesn't give you
different.item1Body: Odoo's AI is Enterprise-only. This works where you already are.
different.item2Body: Enterprise charges ~$25–60 per user/month, for every user.
different.item3Body: The figures are computed by the system; the model only writes them up. That's why it's exact and cheap.

partner.heading: Do you implement Odoo?
partner.line: Offer it to your clients under your brand and resell it.
partner.item2Body: manage all your companies from a single account
partner.item3Label: Installs nothing in the client's Odoo
partner.item3Body: nothing breaks on upgrades, zero maintenance

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes: human confirmation on every write, it respects your Odoo permissions and credentials are encrypted.
faq.q2: Is my data used for training?
faq.a2: TODO (Martin): fill in — which LLM provider data is sent to, retention, and whether it's used for training. Don't ship until completed.
faq.q4: Does it install anything in my Odoo?
faq.a4: No. It connects via a standard API key (XML-RPC).
faq.q5: Can I add my own brand?
faq.a5: Yes: white-label to resell to your clients under your identity.
faq.a6: Free on your own Odoo. To deploy it to your clients, from ~$1/user.

founder.heading: Made by Martin
founder.body: I built it alone, with a simple idea: that anyone in a company can talk to their Odoo without fighting menus. Active development and direct support from me — if you try it and something's off, write me: your feedback literally makes it better.

nudge.title: What you're testing, you can resell under your own brand.
nudge.body: Connect it to your clients' Odoo, with your identity. Free until one of your clients uses it.

apiKeyHelper.title: How to generate your API key in Odoo
apiKeyHelper.step1: In Odoo, open Settings → Account Security.
apiKeyHelper.step3: Under "API Keys", create a new key.
apiKeyHelper.step4: Copy the key and paste it here.
